caseName: Federal Power Commission v. Safe Harbor Water Power Corp.
caseNameFull: Federal Power Commission v. Safe Harbor Water Power Corp.
attorneys: Solicitor General Fahy and Mr. Richard J. Connor for petitioner. Messrs. Charles Markell and E. M. Sturtevant for respondent. Mr. Joseph Sherbow filed a brief on behalf of the Public Service Commission of Maryland, as amicus curiae, in support of petitioner.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied.
